QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_4

question.text: Saraswati PE Fund has paid-in capital of INR 1,000 crore. Cumulative distributions to LPs are INR 400 crore and the residual fair value of unrealised holdings is INR 1,100 crore. Compute DPI, RVPI and TVPI.

explanation.text: The Logic: DPI = Cumulative Distributions / PIC = 400/1000 = 0.40. RVPI = Residual Value / PIC = 1100/1000 = 1.10. TVPI = DPI + RVPI = 0.40 + 1.10 = 1.50. This matches the Section 7.3.4.4 illustration. The Trap: Option A swaps numerators (distribution vs residual value). Option B reorders incorrectly. Option C subtracts instead of adding the two components. Note: The TVPI of 1.50 here is heavily weighted toward RVPI (1.10 of 1.50, or 73% of value) and only 0.40 is from realised distributions.
